portInfo.description: Sitka spreads cruise landings across a deep-water terminal north of town and downtown-adjacent tender/bridge docks. Sitka Sound Cruise Terminal (Sitka Dock Co.) markets visitor services and free downtown shuttles. Visit Sitka’s FAQ is the clearest primary map of assignment codes: most major lines use the Sound terminal with shuttle to Harrigan Centennial Hall; CR ships tender to Crescent Harbor; BR ships use O’Connell Bridge Dock. Do not assume every Sitka call is a downtown walk-off.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Sitka Sound Cruise Terminal — About six miles north of downtown Sitka (Visit Sitka FAQ)

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
